1521032.steps:
In step 4, DNS query generated and sent by DUT keeps same as the query which LAN client PC sent to DUT. In step 5, category information shows in DNS response -Additional records,like:
Option Unknown(15)
Option Code: Unknown(15)
Option Length: 2
Option Data: cf01
the DNS response forwarded to Client keeps same as the response from Neustar Server.
1521032.title: [FUNC] When DNS Filtering is enabled, verify DNS query and DNS response captured on DUT packet monitor.

1521033.steps:
In step 5, DNS response contains category information;
In step 6, the id of category name(check with profile) is the same as the id of Option Data in DNS response packet, like 1(1=Adult).
1521033.title: [FUNC] When DNS filtering is enabled, verify category shown in DNS proxy cache is correct.

1521034.steps: In step 4, DNS response generated and sent by DUT contains Additional Records.
1521034.title: [FUNC] When DNS filtering is enabled, verify DNS response sent from DUT to LAN Client contains Additional Records.

1521035.steps:
In step 6, DNS response contains category information;
In step 7, category shown in DNS proxy cache table is null.
1521035.title: [FUNC] When DNS filtering is disabled, verify category shown in DNS proxy cache is null.

1521036.steps: DNS response generated and sent by DUT does not contain Additional Recoreds.
1521036.title: [FUNC] When DNS filtering is disabled, verify DNS response sent from DUT to LAN client PC does not contain Additional Recoreds.

1521037.steps:
In step 4, the Additional RRs is 0.
In step 5, the Additional RRs is not 0, an Additional records code with type(41) is added to DNS query generated and sent by DUT, the Queries code keeps same as the query which LAN client PC sent to DUT.
1521037.title: [FUNC] When DNS Filtering is enabled, verify DNS query without Additional Options will be added with an Additional records by DUT.

1521038.steps:
In step 5, the Additional RRs is 0.
In step 6, the Additional RRs is 0.
1521038.title: [FUNC] When DNS Filtering is disabled, verify the DNS query without Additional Options is forwarded as original by DUT.
